Is It Good to Use Electric Breast Pumps?
Yes! Electric breast pumps are a great choice for breastfeeding moms looking

for convenience and efficiency. They can help maintain or increase milk supply, especially for working mothers or those with low supply issues. Choosing the right electric breast pump means finding one that offers strong suction power, quiet operation, and easy-to-use features. A comfortable and effective electric breast pump can make your breastfeeding journey smoother and more successful.
How Many Minutes Should I Use an Electric Breast Pump?
For most moms, starting with 15–20 minutes per pumping session is recommended, gradually adjusting based on your milk supply and comfort. Every mom’s needs are different, so listen to your body and pump according to what feels best for you.
Factors like your milk production, your baby’s feeding schedule, and your comfort all play a role. Stop pumping if you feel any discomfort or when your breasts feel empty to avoid over-pumping, which can cause soreness or irritation. Using your electric breast pump correctly helps maintain a healthy milk supply and a comfortable breastfeeding experience.
Do Wearable Pumps Decrease Milk Supply?
A wearable pump does not decrease milk supply, as long as it provides strong and effective suction. Suction strength is key to fully emptying the breast, which helps maintain a healthy milk supply.
Wearable pumps like the Momcozy S12 Pro are designed with high suction power to ensure efficient milk removal, so you can pump hands-free without compromising your milk production.
Which Is Less Painful: Manual or Electric Breast Pump?
Pain during pumping varies from mom to mom, but many breastfeeding mothers find electric breast pumps to be less painful because they offer multiple adjustable suction levels and modes, allowing you to customize comfort and reduce nipple pain. However, using too high suction, especially with sensitive nipples or elastic nipples, can still cause discomfort.
Some moms prefer manual breast pumps because they provide more control over suction and pumping speed, which can help minimize pain. Yet, manual pumps may cause hand and wrist fatigue when used for long sessions.
Regardless of whether you choose a manual or electric breast pump, selecting the right breast pump flange size and adjusting the suction level correctly are essential for reducing pain, preventing nipple soreness, and ensuring a comfortable pumping experience.
How Do I Choose an Electric Breast Pump?
Choosing the right electric breast pump can make all the difference for busy moms. Here are key factors to consider:
Portability: If you pump on the go or at work, choose a lightweight, portable breast pump like the Momcozy M6 that fits your lifestyle.
Suction Power: Look for a pump with strong and adjustable suction to effectively express milk and maintain a healthy milk supply.
Comfort: The right fit matters — try different pumps and flanges to find one that feels comfortable and prevents nipple pain or discomfort.
Features: Consider useful features such as double pumping for efficiency, quiet operation for discretion, rechargeable batteries for convenience, and app control for personalized pumping sessions.
Picking the right electric breast pump tailored to your needs helps make breastfeeding easier, more comfortable, and more efficient.
How should I clean and sterilize M6 accessories?
Wash M6 accessories with regular dish soap. If sterilization is needed, boil them for 5 minutes, then air dry, wipe dry, or use low-temperature drying. Do not use microwave sterilization. For steam sterilizing, drying, or hot-air drying, keep the temperature within 100°C / 212°F when possible and do not exceed 110°C / 230°F. M6 accessories can also be cleaned in a Momcozy bottle washer, but please do not use Storage mode. Avoid alcohol-based cleaners, as they may affect the soft silicone on the flange.
Why does the suction feel weaker after cleaning or sterilizing?
Suction may feel weaker if the milk collector or flange is slightly deformed after excessive heat exposure, which can affect the a

irtight seal. Please check whether the accessories are fully dry, properly installed, and free from warping, gaps, or damage. To help maintain strong suction, avoid microwave sterilization and keep steam sterilizing, drying, or hot-air drying within the recommended temperature range.

This is a very convenient pumping set, particularly because you get two pumps so both sides can be expressed at the same time while still having your hands free. They sit inside a bra without tubes or wires getting in the way and feel considerably less restrictive than a traditional pump.There are three modes and nine suction levels, which gives plenty of adjustment as comfort can vary quite a bit from one person to another. The display is clear and useful for keeping an eye on the time, battery and setting. Battery life has also been good, and having a proper storage case makes the set much easier to keep together or take out of the house.There are only four washable parts per pump, so cleaning isn't as much of a chore as I initially expected. The collectors hold a generous amount and the different flange inserts supplied are particularly useful, although getting the correct fit is important for both comfort and effective pumping.These are quite expensive compared with many wearable pumps, but they do feel like a more premium product and the freedom of being able to move around while pumping is a big advantage. I would still take a little time initially to experiment with the fit and suction level rather than immediately using the strongest setting, as stronger isn't necessarily more comfortable or more effective.
